purpose: block-stratified error bars on the emission policy, on the catalogue and on the new-fault-like proxy population, from an exact additive decomposition of the official metric plus a block bootstrap

partition.assignment: greedy LPT: blocks dealt by descending fault mass to the fold with the smallest normalised load (fault/target + valid/target)

prediction.note: The input carries a continuous probability field, so both the floor and the width axis are measured.

restriction.note: only the blocks of fold 2 (the blocks the model TRAINED on); this is a generalisation reading ONLY if --pred came from a model trained with training.holdout=spatial_blocks and training.block_fold=2 on the same partition (block_px=512, folds=4, seed 0, mode balanced)

bootstrap.unit: spatial block, resampled with replacement, recomposed from the additive metric components

reliability.note: 25 independent resampling units: the CI95 is readable and comparable with other runs of this script that score a similar number of blocks. It quantifies spatial sampling noise in this footprint, not uncertainty over truth definitions or over the hidden set.

interpretation.interpretation: DTI is not decomposable over blocks: TP_w sums over truth pixels while the FP penalty is a global mass term, so a candidate can win in most blocks and still lose globally.  Per-block numbers are for VARIANCE (the block bootstrap) and for locating where a score comes from; the global DTI stays the selection statistic.  No candidate won a majority of blocks while losing globally in this run.

verdict.note: Candidates are derived from the SHIPPED raster, so floors below the applied floor and un-thinned variants are not recoverable here; the runner sweep (.github/workflows/proxy-eval.yml) covers those.  Per-block catalogue DTI is in-domain (the shipped model trained on every label); per-block proxy-only DTI is not, because those pixels are absent from the training labels by construction.

pruning.rule: per-block rows dropped only for emissions that duplicate another candidate's emission; global numbers and the twin reference kept
pruning.applied_after: bootstrap, sign agreement, verdict and the reproduction check (none of which read a duplicate's rows)
